href=\"#using-the-api\">\u003c/a>\u003c/h3>\n\u003cp>Let&#x27;s use a simple 
scenario to demonstrate how to use the Yelp Places API. Imagine you are 
building an app to help people find great food nearby and you want to provide 
a search experience.\u003c/p>\n\u003col>\n\u003cli>A user enters 
&quot;del&quot; in the search box.\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>They are provided a few 
autocomplete suggestions, like &quot;delivery&quot; and 
&quot;delis&quot;.\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>They choose &quot;delis&quot; to see 
what options they have nearby.\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>They choose 
&quot;delivery&quot; since they do not want to go out to get the 
food.\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>They are offered a list of all the restaurants which 
deliver to their location.\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>They choose one, view the 
restaurant details and reviews, then make the decision to order 
delivery.\u003c/li>\n\u003c/ol>\n\u003cp>The following is how you can use the 
Yelp Places API to implement this experience.\u003c/p>\n\u003ch4

class=\"heading-anchor-icon fa fa-anchor\" href=\"#get-autocomplete-suggestions
-based-on-users-input\">\u003c/a>\u003c/h4>\n\u003cp>As the user is typing, 
you can monitor the user&#x27;s input and call our autocomplete endpoint in 
real time. It&#x27;s always good to also provide the latitude and longitude 
parameters so that you receive suggestions on businesses based on 
location.\u003c/p>\n\u003cdiv class=\"CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial

a simple scenario to demonstrate how to use the Yelp Places API. Imagine you 
are building an app to help people find great food nearby and you want to 
provide a search experience.\n\n1. A user enters \"del\" in the search 
box.\n2. They are provided a few autocomplete suggestions, like \"delivery\" 
and \"delis\".\n3. They choose \"delis\" to see what options they have 
nearby.\n4. They choose \"delivery\" since they do not want to go out to get 
the food.\n5. They are offered a list of all the restaurants which deliver to 
their location.\n6. They choose one, view the restaurant details and reviews, 
then make the decision to order delivery.\n\nThe following is how you can use 
the Yelp Places API to implement this experience.\n\n#### Get autocomplete 
suggestions based on user's input\n\nAs the user is typing, you can monitor 
the user's input and call our autocomplete endpoint in real time. It's always 
good to also provide the latitude and longitude parameters so that you receive 
suggestions on businesses based on location.\n\n```shell\nGET https://api.yelp.
com/v3/autocomplete?text=del&latitude=37.786882&longitude=-122.399972\n```\n\nI
n the response body below, you can see that it's returning suggestions for 
terms, businesses and categories.\n\n```json\n{\n  \"terms\": [\n    {\n      
\"text\": \"Delivery\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"businesses\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": 
\"YqvoyaNvtoC8N5dA8pD2JA\",\n      \"name\": \"Delfina\"\n    },\n    {\n      
\"id\": \"vu6PlPyKptsT6oEq50qOzA\",\n      \"name\": \"Delarosa\"\n    },\n    
{\n      \"id\": \"bai6umLcCNy9cXql0Js2RQ\",\n      \"name\": \"Pizzeria 
Delfina\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"categories\": [\n    {\n      \"alias\": 
\"delis\",\n      \"title\": \"Delis\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"alias\": 
\"fooddeliveryservices\",\n      \"title\": \"Food Delivery Services\"\n    
},\n    {\n      \"alias\": \"couriers\",\n      \"title\": \"Couriers & 
Delivery Services\"\n    }\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n#### Search for businesses with a 
keyword\n\nOnce the user selects \"delis\" from the autocomplete suggestions 
as the search keyword, you can call the Search endpoint to find restaurants 
matching the keyword. Again, by providing the latitude and longitude 
parameters, you'll get the best results which take location into 
consideration.\n\n```shell\nGET https://api.yelp.com/v3/businesses/search?term=
delis&latitude=37.786882&longitude=-122.399972\n```\n\nIn the response body 
below, you'll get a list of businesses with valuable information such as name, 
address, phone number, Yelp rating, price levels, and review counts. The URL 
of the restaurant points the corresponding Yelp business page. Deeplinks 
ensure that the Yelp mobile app opens to the desired page, if installed. If 
not installed, users are taken to Yelp's mobile website.\n\n```json\n{\n  
\"total\": 1316,\n  \"businesses\": [\n    {\n      \"rating\": 4.5,\n      
\"price\": \"$$\",\n      \"phone\": \"+14154212337\",\n      \"id\": 
\"molinari-delicatessen-san-francisco\",\n      \"categories\": [\n        {\n 
         \"alias\": \"delis\",\n          \"title\": \"Delis\"\n        }\n    
  ],\n      \"review_count\": 910,\n      \"name\": \"Molinari 
Delicatessen\",\n      \"url\": 
\"https://www.yelp.com/biz/molinari-delicatessen-san-francisco\",\n      
\"coordinates\": {\n        \"latitude\": 37.7983818054199,\n        
\"longitude\": -122.407821655273\n      },\n      \"image_url\": 
\"http://s3-media4.fl.yelpcdn.com/bphoto/6He-NlZrAv2mDV-yg6jW3g/o.jpg\",\n     
 \"location\": {\n        \"city\": \"San Francisco\",\n        \"country\": 
\"US\",\n        \"address2\": \"\",\n        \"address3\": \"\",\n        
\"state\": \"CA\",\n        \"address1\": \"373 Columbus Ave\",\n        
\"zip_code\": \"94133\"\n      }\n    },\n    // ...\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n#### 
Search for businesses supporting delivery\n\nOnce the user selects 
\"Delivery\" from the autocomplete suggestions as the search keyword, you can 
call the Transaction Search endpoint to find businesses which deliver to the 
user's location. Here the latitude and longitude parameters are required since 
delivery availability depends on the location of the delivery. You can also 
pass in a different location to implement the case where the user will request 
delivery from a different location.\n\n```shell\nGET https://api.yelp.com/v3/tr
ansactions/delivery/search?latitude=37.786882&longitude=-122.399972\n```\n\nThe
 response body right now is pretty much the same as search endpoint response 
body.\n\n```json\n{\n  \"total\": 25,\n  \"businesses\": [\n    {\n      
\"rating\": 4,\n      \"image_url\": \"\",\n      \"name\": \"North India 
Restaurant\",\n      \"url\": 
\"https://www.yelp.com/biz/north-india-restaurant-san-francisco\",\n      
\"review_count\": 551,\n      \"coordinates\": {\n        \"latitude\": 
null,\n        \"longitude\": null\n      },\n      \"id\": 
\"north-india-restaurant-san-francisco\",\n      \"categories\": [\n        
{\n          \"alias\": \"indpak\",\n          \"title\": \"Indian\"\n        
}\n      ]\n    },\n    // ...\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n#### Get business details and 
reviews\n\nFinally, you can call the Business Details endpoint and Reviews 
endpoint to retrieve business details and up to 3 review excerpts.\n\nTo get 
business detail information, you can make the following call.\n\n```shell\nGET 
https://api.yelp.com/v3/businesses/north-india-restaurant-san-francisco\n```\n\
nIn the response body right now, you'll get up to 3 additional photos and 
hours of the business.\n\n```json\n{\n  \"rating\": 4,\n  \"price\": \"$$\",\n
